full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《非磁性杂质对微波驱动超导体非平衡相变的影响》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Electric Hidden Unconventional Collinear Magnetism in 2D (PT)-Symmetric Antiferromagnets
full_list.title_zh: 二维 (PT) 对称反铁磁体中的电隐藏非常规共线磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric hidden unconventional collinear magnetism, in which a perpendicular electric field ((E_z)) lifts the (PT)-enforced degeneracy and selectively releases the hidden crystallographic constraints in conventional 2D antiferromagnets to drive emergent magnetic phases, has remained largely unexplored. Here we establish a complete symmetry classification of all 88 collinear spin layer groups (cSLGs) compatible with conventional (PT)-symmetric antiferromagnets, and show that the (E_z) drives the system into three distinct classes of unconventional collinear magnetism: type-IV magnetism (Class-I, 23 cSLGs), altermagnetism (Class-II, 34 cSLGs), and fully compensated ferrimagnetism (Class-III, 31 cSLGs). We illustrate these categories using the most common and feasibly exfoliable 2D candidate materials. These include Sr₂CaCr₂P₂O₉ and Sr₂CaCr₂As₂O₉ (Class-I), BaMnGe and MnPS₃ (Class-II), and Sr₃Fe₂O₅Cl₂ and bilayer MnBi₂Te₄ (Class-III). We further demonstrate that the (E_z) generates distinctly different spin-splitting fingerprints across the three classes, yielding distinct spin-dependent responses: the electric Hall effect in Class-I, spin-polarized transport in Class-II, and the electric reversible magneto-optical Kerr effect in Class-III. Our work not only closes a complete internal cycle from conventional to unconventional collinear magnetism in 2D antiferromagnets, but also establishes a viable all-electrical compensated magnetism platform and control scheme for future spintronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电隐藏的非常规共线磁力，其中垂直电场 ((E_z)) 提升 (PT) 强制的简并性并选择性地释放传统 2D 反铁磁体中隐藏的晶体学约束以驱动涌现的磁相，该磁力在很大程度上仍未得到探索。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电隐藏的非常规共线磁力，其中垂直电场 ((E_z)) 提升 (PT) 强制的简并性并选择性地释放传统 2D 反铁磁体中隐藏的晶体学约束以驱动涌现的磁相，该磁力在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们建立了与传统 (PT) 对称反铁磁体兼容的所有 88 个共线自旋层组 (cSLG) 的完整对称分类，并表明 (E_z) 将系统驱动为三个不同类别的非常规共线磁性：IV 型磁性（I 类，23 个 cSLG）、交变磁性（II 类，34 个 cSLG）和完全补偿的亚铁磁性（III 类，31 个 cSLG）。我们使用最常见且可行的可剥离二维候选材料来说明这些类别。其中包括 Sr2CaCr2P2O9 和 Sr2CaCr2As2O9（I 类）、BaMnGe 和 MnPS3（II 类）以及 Sr3Fe2O5Cl2 和双层 MnBi2Te4（III 类）。我们进一步证明，(E_z) 在三个类别中产生明显不同的自旋分裂指纹，产生不同的自旋相关响应：I 类中的电霍尔效应、II 类中的自旋极化输运以及 III 类中的电可逆磁光克尔效应。我们的工作不仅封闭了二维反铁磁体中从传统到非常规共线磁性的完整内部循环，而且还为未来的自旋电子应用建立了可行的全电补偿磁性平台和控制方案。

full_list.title_en: Gate-Switchable Josephson Diode Effect in Graphene via Magnetochiral Anisotropy
full_list.title_zh: 石墨烯中的栅极可切换约瑟夫森二极管效应（通过磁性各向异性）
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2312.02692v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Josephson diode effect originating from magnetochiral anisotropy has thus far been realized primarily in conventional two-dimensional electron gases. Here, we propose a graphene-based Josephson junction as a broadly gate-tunable platform for nonreciprocal supercurrent transport. We demonstrate that the nonreciprocal critical current not only reverses its sign when graphene is switched from n- to p-type doping via electrostatic gating, but its efficiency can also be continuously tuned from zero up to sim 40%. This gate-controlled polarity switching and efficiency modulation---unique to the chiral nature of Dirac fermions in graphene---has no counterpart in conventional semiconductor systems, positioning the graphene Josephson diode as a highly versatile component for advanced superconducting circuits.
full_list.abstract_zh: 迄今为止，源自磁性各向异性的约瑟夫森二极管效应主要在传统的二维电子气体中实现。在这里，我们提出了一种基于石墨烯的约瑟夫森结，作为非互易超电流传输的广泛栅极可调平台。我们证明，当石墨烯通过静电栅极从n型掺杂切换到p型掺杂时，非互易临界电流不仅会逆转其符号，而且其效率也可以从零持续调整到SIM 40%。这种栅控极性开关和效率调制--这是石墨烯中狄拉克费米子手性特性的独特之处--在传统半导体系统中没有对应物，将石墨烯约瑟夫森二极管定位为先进超导电路的高度通用组件。

full_list.title_en: Hidden piezo-Hall effect
full_list.title_zh: 隐藏式压电霍尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extensive studies of hidden spin polarization have established a broad class of hidden phenomena in quantum materials. Here, we introduce the hidden piezo-Hall effect, in which strain induces finite anomalous Hall conductivities (AHCs) in individual sectors while the global AHC remains zero. At zero strain, neither the full system nor its sectors exhibit an anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Under uniaxial strain, however, opposite sector AHCs emerge while their sum remains canceled. We establish this effect for a d-wave hidden altermagnet using a tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for the experimentally synthesized material RbV₂Te₂O. Rotating the strain direction from the x to the y axis reverses the signs of the sector AHCs without generating a net Hall response. The same symmetry mechanism may also give rise to hidden piezomagneto-optical, piezo-thermal Hall, piezo-Nernst, and piezo-Ettingshausen effects. Our work extends hidden physics to strain-controlled transport and identifies RbV₂Te₂O as a promising candidate for experimental verification.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对隐藏自旋极化的广泛研究已经在量子材料中建立了广泛的隐藏现象。在这里，我们引入了隐藏的压电霍尔效应，其中应变在各个扇区中引起有限的反常霍尔电导率（AHC），而全局 AHC 保持为零。在零应变下，整个系统及其扇区均不表现出反常霍尔效应 (AHE)。然而，在单轴应变下，相反扇区的 AHC 出现，但它们的总和仍然被抵消。我们使用紧束缚模型和第一性原理计算对实验合成材料 RbV2Te2O 建立了 d 波隐藏交变磁体的这种效应。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《隐藏式压电霍尔效应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Large exchange bias from coupled antiferromagnetic order and glassy magnetic freezing in Co₀.₃₆NbS₂
full_list.title_zh: Co₀.₃₆NbS2 中耦合反铁磁序和玻璃态磁冻结产生的大交换偏差
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetization measurements on single-crystalline Co₀.₃₆NbS₂ reveal antiferromagnetic order near TN simeq 26 K and a lower-temperature history-dependent magnetic response consistent with glassy freezing of a subset of magnetic moments. After field cooling, M(H) loops exhibit a sizable exchange-bias shift, reaching |HEB| simeq 4.4 kOe at 1.8 K for a 70 kOe field-cooling sweep protocol. The training effect, field-sweep and cooling-field protocol dependence, and disappearance of the bias near a blocking temperature TB simeq 12 K, well below TN, support an interpretation in which frozen uncompensated moments are exchange-coupled to an antiferromagnetic matrix. These results suggest that antiferromagnetic-glassy-moment coupling may provide a broader route to exchange bias in off-stoichiometric magnetic NbS₂ intercalates.
full_list.abstract_zh: 单晶 Co₀.₃₆NbS2 的磁化测量揭示了 TN simeq 26 K 附近的反铁磁序以及与磁矩子集的玻璃态冻结一致的低温历史相关磁响应。现场冷却后，M(H) 环路表现出相当大的交换偏置偏移，达到 |HEB|对于 70 kOe 现场冷却扫描协议，1.8 K 时 simeq 4.4 kOe。训练效果、场扫描和冷却场协议依赖性以及远低于 TN 的阻断温度 TB simeq 12 K 附近的偏置消失，支持冻结未补偿力矩与反铁磁矩阵交换耦合的解释。

full_list.title_en: Linear Ensemble-Constrained Quantum Monte Carlo: From Dilute Fermi Gas to Flat-Band Ferromagnetism
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Linear Ensemble-Constrained Quantum Monte Carlo: From Dilute Fermi Gas to Flat-Band Ferromagnetism
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.08552v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a finite-temperature canonical-ensemble determinant quantum Monte Carlo algorithm that enforces an exact fermion number and enables numerically stable simulations of correlated lattice fermions. We propose a stabilized QR update that reduces the computational complexity from standard cubic scaling O(β N³) to linear scaling O(β N Nₑ²) with respect to the system size N, where Nₑ is the particle number. This yields a dramatic speedup in dilute regimes (Nₑ ll N), opening unbiased access to large-scale simulations of strongly correlated low-density phases. We validate the method on the dilute Fermi gas with onsite Hubbard interactions, observing the suppression of the fermion sign problem in the dilute limit. Furthermore, we apply this approach to a one-dimensional flat-band system, where the canonical ensemble allows for precise control over filling. We reveal a ferromagnetic instability at low temperatures in the half-filling regime. Our linear-scaling approach provides a powerful tool for investigating emergent phenomena in dilute quantum matter.

full_list.title_en: Magnetoelectric Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Centrosymmetric Solids
full_list.title_zh: 中心对称固体中的磁电体光伏效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is commonly believed that a bulk photovoltaic current requires broken spatial inversion symmetry. However, in this work, we demonstrate that dc photocurrents can arise in centrosymmetric solids from the bilinear coupling between the electric and magnetic components of light. This magnetoelectric bulk photovoltaic effect (MBPE) has a quantum-geometric origin in the dipole moments of the Zeeman quantum metric and Zeeman Berry curvature. We identify four distinct MBPE mechanisms, including time-reversal-even and time-reversal-odd injection-like and shift-like photocurrents driven by linearly or circularly polarized light. Our symmetry analysis shows that the MBPE is allowed in broad classes of two-dimensional centrosymmetric nonmagnetic and magnetic materials under normally incident light. As representative examples, we predict sizable MBPEs in centrosymmetric monolayer Pt₂HgSe₃ and altermagnetic RuF₄, with current densities on the order of 1~mA/m. Notably, the injection-like photocurrent in RuF₄ reverses sign upon switching either the light helicity or the Néel vector. Our results extend the bulk photovoltaic effect to centrosymmetric solids and open new opportunities for electrical readout of altermagnetic order.
full_list.abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，大容量光伏电流需要打破空间反演对称性。然而，在这项工作中，我们证明了中心对称固体中可以因光的电分量和磁分量之间的双线性耦合而产生直流光电流。这种磁电体光伏效应 (MBPE) 在塞曼量子度量和塞曼贝里曲率的偶极矩中具有量子几何起源。我们确定了四种不同的 MBPE 机制，包括由线性或圆偏振光驱动的时间反转偶数和时间反转奇数注入和移位光电流。我们的对称性分析表明，在法向入射光下，MBPE 可以用于多种二维中心对称非磁性和磁性材料。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《中心对称固体中的磁电体光伏效应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Microscopic Compensation of Circular Optical Response in Altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁体中圆形光学响应的微观补偿
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A weak or vanishing circular optical signal need not imply weak helicity-sensitive transitions: it can be the residual of much larger opposing microscopic contributions. We resolve the finite-frequency interband Kubo response before summing over transitions and momentum, separating cancellation among transitions at fixed momentum from cancellation across the Brillouin zone. An exactly compensated d-wave model establishes the symmetry benchmark. In MnTe, first-principles Wannier calculations reveal a symmetry-dark Néel orientation with an extended sign-changing circular kernel whose bulk integral vanishes. Reorienting the Néel vector removes this extinction, yet the allowed response remains a small imbalance between large positive- and negative-momentum sectors; the imbalance reverses with photon energy and flips the macroscopic sign. Thus magnetic symmetry decides whether circular response is allowed, whereas microscopic compensation determines how much survives and with what sign. This distinction provides a general framework for interpreting weak, vanishing, and sign-changing magneto-optical signals in compensated magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 弱或消失的圆形光信号不一定意味着弱的螺旋性敏感跃迁：它可以是更大的相反微观贡献的残余物。我们在对跃迁和动量求和之前求解有限频率带间 Kubo 响应，将固定动量跃迁之间的抵消与布里渊区的抵消分开。精确补偿的 d 波模型建立了对称性基准。在 MnTe 中，第一原理 Wannier 计算揭示了对称暗尼尔取向，具有扩展的变号圆形核，其体积积分消失。重新定向尼尔矢量消除了这种灭绝，但允许的反应仍然是大的正动量和负动量部分之间的小不平衡；

full_list.title_en: Modular Landau Analysis of Coupled Phase Transitions: Application to Ferroelectric Liquid Crystals
full_list.title_zh: 耦合相变的模块化Landau分析：在铁电液晶中的应用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26505v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In systems with coupled order parameters, the relaxation of existing order can modify subsequent transitions, while cooperation and competition between emerging modes can produce complex phase sequences. We develop a modular Landau analysis that locally relaxes noncritical parent-phase variables to obtain effective one- and two-mode free energies. The resulting coefficients quantify relaxation-induced changes in transition characteristics and mode coupling, including changes in transition order for even-symmetry modes. The resulting modules are assembled successively along parent branches, and the equilibrium phase sequence is selected by comparing the fully relaxed free energies of the admissible branches. We apply the framework to ferroelectric liquid crystals, where orientational, polar, smectic, and tilt orders interact and give rise to multiple competing pathways, using a uniaxial model with longitudinal polarization. We fit the model to the measurements reported by Strachan et al. [Adv. Sci. 12(3), 2409754 (2025)]. A single thermodynamic parameter set reproduces the observed transition temperatures, transition types, and phase sequence, while capturing the main birefringence trend. Smectic layer spacing is reconstructed separately through a fitted observation map based on the calculated equilibrium tilt.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在具有耦合阶次参数的系统中，现有阶次的松弛可以修改后续的转变，而新兴模式之间的合作和竞争可以产生复杂的相序列。我们开发了一种模块化朗道分析，可以局部松弛非关键母相变量以获得有效的一模和二模自由能。所得系数量化了弛豫引起的过渡特性和模式耦合的变化，包括偶对称模式的过渡阶的变化。所得模块沿着母分支连续组装，并通过比较允许分支的完全松弛自由能来选择平衡相序。我们将该框架应用于铁电液晶，其中取向、极性、近晶和倾斜顺序相互作用，并使用具有纵向偏振的单轴模型产生多个竞争路径。

full_list.title_en: Monolayer van der Waals kagome lattice for high-temperature flat-band physics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Monolayer van der Waals kagome lattice for high-temperature flat-band physics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome lattice materials host a remarkably rich landscape of novel quantum phenomena, all arising from the intrinsic interplay of topology, correlation, and frustration. While previous studies have been mostly limited to bulk three-dimensional (3D) kagome crystals, the realization of a true two-dimensional (2D) kagome system has remained a long-standing goal, to unlock fundamentally new physics and engineering pathways inaccessible in 3D systems. In this work, we establish the first ideal 2D monolayer kagome lattices by leveraging a novel and versatile van der Waals (vdW) kagome family, A2T3X4 (A = K, Rb, Cs; T = Ni, Pd, Pt; X = S, Se). Our nano-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (nano-ARPES) directly characterizes the electronic structure of A2T3X4 down to the monolayer limit, notably revealing an isolated kagome-derived flat band just below the Fermi level. Via gate-engineering of 2D A2T3X4, the kagome flat band can be further tuned to the Fermi level, allowing direct access to the partially filled flat band physics and establishing a qualitatively new 2D flat band platform. Compared to existing moire-based artificial flat band systems, this vdW kagome-based intrinsic flat band system realizes more than 220 times higher flat band electron density, opening an entirely new density and energy regime for exploring 2D flat band physics. Harnessing this high-electron-density flat band in 2D vdW kagome system provides a clear pathway to scale emergent flat band phenomena - such as fractional quantum anomalous Hall states - to far higher temperatures than currently achievable, as long-envisioned in theory and further supported by our many-body calculations.

full_list.title_en: Quantum control as renormalization group flow
full_list.title_zh: 作为重正化群流的量子控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26154v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Renormalization Group (RG) establishes relations between effective descriptions of physical systems at different scales; in Hamiltonian RG, these relations induce a flow in the space of Hamiltonians. In direct correspondence, we design an RG framework for quantum control by constructing a flow in the space of time-dependent Hamiltonians. A prescribed control subspace, selected to contain only experimentally accessible terms, forms the fixed-point manifold, while the flow preserves the target unitary and monotonically reduces the Hamiltonian weight outside this subspace. Exploiting the freedom in constructing the flow, we introduce flow-equation engineering to enhance the versatility of the framework for diverse control problems, including time-periodic and open-interval smooth protocols with prescribed endpoints. We provide two disparate applications to exhibit the utility of our approach: (i) Nonperturbative Floquet engineering beyond the regime of validity of high-frequency expansions, which we demonstrate by constructing an implementable time-periodic protocol for the Haldane model; (ii) Accessible fast-forward driving from unit-fidelity counterdiabatic evolution, which we showcase for large transverse-field Ising chains away from the adiabatic regime by compressing the long-range multibody adiabatic gauge potential into the original time-dependent Ising control schedules. Our control RG framework reveals a unifying perspective on Hamiltonian engineering and unitary quantum control, and can serve as an organizing principle behind seemingly disparate nonequilibrium quantum dynamics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 重整化群（RG）建立了不同尺度物理系统的有效描述之间的关系；在哈密顿量 RG 中，这些关系引起哈密顿量空间中的流动。在直接对应中，我们通过在时间相关的哈密顿量空间中构建流来设计量子控制的 RG 框架。选择仅包含实验可访问项的规定控制子空间形成定点流形，而流保留目标酉并单调减少该子空间外部的哈密顿权重。利用构建流的自由度，我们引入流方程工程来增强框架针对各种控制问题的多功能性，包括具有指定端点的时间周期和开区间平滑协议。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 重整化群（RG）建立了不同尺度物理系统的有效描述之间的关系；在哈密顿量 RG 中，这些关系引起哈密顿量空间中的流动。在直接对应中，我们通过在时间相关的哈密顿量空间中构建流来设计量子控制的 RG 框架。选择仅包含实验可访问项的规定控制子空间形成定点流形，而流保留目标酉并单调减少该子空间外部的哈密顿权重。利用构建流的自由度，我们引入流方程工程来增强框架针对各种控制问题的多功能性，包括具有指定端点的时间周期和开区间平滑协议。我们提供了两个不同的应用程序来展示我们方法的实用性：（i）超出高频展开有效性范围的非微扰 Floquet 工程，我们通过为 Haldane 模型构建可实现的时间周期协议来证明这一点； （ii）单位保真度反绝热演化的可访问快进驱动，我们通过将远程多体绝热规范势压缩到原始的时间相关伊辛控制计划中，展示了远离绝热状态的大横向场伊辛链。我们的控制 RG 框架揭示了哈密顿工程和酉量子控制的统一视角，并且可以作为看似不同的非平衡量子动力学背后的组织原则。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《作为重正化群流的量子控制》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Shear SAW piezoelectricity of single-crystalline LiNbO₃ films grown on 42cⁱrc YX-LiTaO₃ substrates by DLI-CVD
full_list.title_zh: DLI-CVD 在 42cⁱrc YX-LiTaO₃ 衬底上生长的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的剪切声表面波压电性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24639v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct growth of single-crystalline LiNbO₃ films with technologically relevant nonpolar orientations and a single ferroelectric domain state remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the epitaxial growth of a 320-nm-thick, single-domain 42deg YX-oriented LiNbO₃ film on a congruent 42deg YX-cut LiTaO₃ substrate by direct liquid injection chemical vapor deposition. The deposition temperature was limited to 600degC to preserve the ferroelectric domain state of the LiTaO₃ substrate. X-ray diffraction confirmed that the LiNbO₃ film inherited the substrate orientation and domain state and exhibited no detectable secondary phases. The LN rocking-curve full width at half maximum was 0.011deg, approaching the instrumental resolution and demonstrating its high crystalline quality. Single-port leaky surface acoustic wave (LSAW) resonators with a wavelength of 4,mum were fabricated on the LiNbO₃/LiTaO₃ heterostructure and on a bare LiTaO₃ reference substrate. At approximately 1 GHz, the LiNbO₃/LiTaO₃-based resonators exhibited an electromechanical coupling coefficient of about 13%, compared to 8.5% for the reference LiTaO₃-based resonators. These results demonstrate that direct epitaxial growth can produce high-quality, strongly piezoelectric LiNbO₃ films and provide a route toward thickness-controlled layered substrates for high-performance acoustic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 具有技术相关的非极性取向和单一铁电畴态的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的直接生长仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了通过直接液体注入化学气相沉积在全等 42 度 YX 切割 LiTaO 基板上外延生长 320 nm 厚、单畴 42 度 YX 取向 LiNbO 薄膜。沉积温度限制在 600℃，以保持 LiTaO3 基底的铁电畴状态。 X射线衍射证实LiNbO₃薄膜继承了基底取向和磁畴状态，并且没有表现出可检测到的第二相。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 具有技术相关的非极性取向和单一铁电畴态的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的直接生长仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了通过直接液体注入化学气相沉积在全等 42 度 YX 切割 LiTaO 基板上外延生长 320 nm 厚、单畴 42 度 YX 取向 LiNbO 薄膜。沉积温度限制在 600℃，以保持 LiTaO3 基底的铁电畴状态。 X射线衍射证实LiNbO₃薄膜继承了基底取向和磁畴状态，并且没有表现出可检测到的第二相。 LN 摇摆曲线半峰全宽为 0.011 度，接近仪器分辨率并证明其高结晶质量。在 LiNbO₃/LiTaO₃ 异质结构和裸露的 LiTaO₃ 参考基板上制造了波长为 4,mum 的单端口泄漏表面声波 (LSAW) 谐振器。在大约 1 GHz 时，LiNbO3/LiTaO3 基谐振器的机电耦合系数约为 13%，而参考 LiTaO3 基谐振器的机电耦合系数为 8.5%。这些结果表明，直接外延生长可以生产高质量、强压电LiNbO₃薄膜，并为高性能声学器件的厚度控制层状基板提供了一条途径。
full_list.summary: 具有技术相关的非极性取向和单一铁电畴态的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的直接生长仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们展示了通过直接液体注入化学气相沉积在全等 42 度 YX 切割 LiTaO 基板上外延生长 320 nm 厚、单畴 42 度 YX 取向 LiNbO 薄膜。沉积温度限制在 600℃，以保持 LiTaO3 基底的铁电畴状态。 X射线衍射证实LiNbO₃薄膜继承了基底取向和磁畴状态，并且没有表现出可检测到的第二相。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《DLI-CVD 在 42cⁱrc YX-LiTaO₃ 衬底上生长的单晶 LiNbO₃ 薄膜的剪切声表面波压电性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Stabilization of Ferroelectric Domains via Interfacial Strain in HoFeO3- BaTiO3 Nanofiber Heterostructures for Enhanced Hybrid Energy Harvesting
full_list.title_zh: 通过 HoFeO3-BaTiO3 纳米纤维异质结构中的界面应变稳定铁电域，以增强混合能量收集
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Piezoelectric nanogenerators (PENGs) are an attractive platform for self-powered mechanical-energy harvesting, but their output is often limited by depolarization fields, charge leakage, and inefficient stress transfer to the active dipoles, particularly in polymer-dominated composites. Here we report HoFeO3-BaTiO3 (HFO-BTO) nanofiber heterostructures prepared by alternating sol-gel electrospinning, in which orthorhombic HoFeO3 (Pbnm) and tetragonal BaTiO3 (P4mm) coexist in intimate contact. Rietveld-refined X-ray diffraction, high-resolution transmission electron microscopy, and Raman spectroscopy indicate interfacial lattice distortion. Polarization-electric field loops show that the heterostructure retains a polarization comparable to that of BaTiO3 (16.39 vs 15.80 microcoulombs per square centimeter at zero field) while its switching-current maximum moves to a higher field (about 7 vs about 3.5 kilovolts per centimeter), consistent with strain-stabilized ferroelectric domains. When the nanofibers are encapsulated in polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) and excited under cyclic impact, the device produces a hybrid output: the piezoelectric response of the strained BaTiO3 is supplemented by a triboelectric contribution from contact electrification. The HFO-BTO device delivers open-circuit voltage peaks of about +6 volts and -8 volts and a power density of 24.31 microwatts per cubic centimeter at a 4.7 megaohm load. This is 2.4 times the value for an identically fabricated BaTiO3 device (10.00 microwatts per cubic centimeter) and 8.7 times that of the HoFeO3 device (2.78 microwatts per cubic centimeter). These results link interface-driven lattice distortion to improved electromechanical output and identify all-oxide nanofiber heterostructures as a promising route to lead-free energy harvesting.
full_list.abstract_zh: 压电纳米发电机（PENG）是自供电机械能收集的一个有吸引力的平台，但它们的输出通常受到去极化场、电荷泄漏和活性偶极子的低效应力转移的限制，特别是在聚合物为主的复合材料中。在这里，我们报道了通过交替溶胶-凝胶静电纺丝制备的HoFeO3-BaTiO3（HFO-BTO）纳米纤维异质结构，其中正交晶系HoFeO3（Pbnm）和四方晶系BaTiO3（P4mm）紧密接触共存。 Rietveld 改进的 X 射线衍射、高分辨率透射电子显微镜和拉曼光谱表明界面晶格畸变。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 压电纳米发电机（PENG）是自供电机械能收集的一个有吸引力的平台，但它们的输出通常受到去极化场、电荷泄漏和活性偶极子的低效应力转移的限制，特别是在聚合物为主的复合材料中。在这里，我们报道了通过交替溶胶-凝胶静电纺丝制备的HoFeO3-BaTiO3（HFO-BTO）纳米纤维异质结构，其中正交晶系HoFeO3（Pbnm）和四方晶系BaTiO3（P4mm）紧密接触共存。 Rietveld 改进的 X 射线衍射、高分辨率透射电子显微镜和拉曼光谱表明界面晶格畸变。极化电场环路表明，异质结构保留了与 BaTiO3 相当的极化（零场下为每平方厘米 16.39 微库伦与 15.80 微库伦），而其开关电流最大值则移至更高场（每厘米约 7 千伏与约 3.5 千伏），这与应变稳定铁电域一致。当纳米纤维封装在聚二甲基硅氧烷 (PDMS) 中并在循环冲击下激发时，该设备会产生混合输出：应变 BaTiO3 的压电响应由接触起电的摩擦起电贡献进行补充。 HFO-BTO 器件在 4.7 兆欧负载下可提供约 +6 伏和 -8 伏的开路电压峰值，功率密度为每立方厘米 24.31 微瓦。这是相同制造的 BaTiO3 器件（每立方厘米 10.00 微瓦）值的 2.4 倍，是 HoFeO3 器件（每立方厘米 2.78 微瓦）的 8.7 倍。这些结果将界面驱动的晶格畸变与改进的机电输出联系起来，并确定全氧化物纳米纤维异质结构是无铅能量收集的有前途的途径。

full_list.title_en: Thermal Responses of Spin Density and Spin Current Induced by Bogoliubov Fermi Surfaces in Proximity Superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 邻近超导体中 Bogoliubov 费米面引起的自旋密度和自旋电流的热响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces in s-wave proximity superconducting systems provides a unique platform for generating nontrivial spin responses in the presence of spin-orbit coupling. In this work, we investigate temperature-gradient driven responses of spin polarization and spin current in such a proximity system related to Fe(Te,Se). The interplay of in-plane magnetization, superconductivity, and nematicity gives rise to nontrivial Berry curvature and spin-related hybrid Berry curvature on the Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, which are shown to lead to finite thermally driven nonequilibrium spin polarization and spin Nernst effect. We find that the responses are strongly enhanced by the emergence of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, and are linear in temperature at low temperatures, rendering a unique spintronic character of Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces.
full_list.abstract_zh: s波邻近超导系统中博戈柳博夫费米面的出现提供了一个独特的平台，可以在自旋轨道耦合的情况下产生非平凡的自旋响应。在这项工作中，我们研究了与 Fe(Te,Se) 相关的邻近系统中自旋极化和自旋电流的温度梯度驱动响应。面内磁化、超导性和向列性的相互作用在博戈柳波夫费米面上产生了非平凡的贝里曲率和自旋相关的混合贝里曲率，这被证明会导致有限的热驱动非平衡自旋极化和自旋能斯特效应。

full_list.title_en: Tunable anisotropy of high-harmonic generation in ferroelectric NbOI2
full_list.title_zh: 铁电 NbOI2 中高次谐波产生的可调谐各向异性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: he generation of even-order harmonic spectra from inversion symmetry breaking is well known, however, the tunability of the intensity and angular anisotropy on various harmonics orders remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate the second and fourth-harmonics in the ferroelectric NbOI2 exhibit distinct wavelength-dependence and anisotropies in the near-infrared regime. In particular, as the wavelength of incident light is tuned from 2150 nm to 2450 nm, the second-harmonic remains strongest for excitation along the ferroelectric polar axis, whereas the polarization of the fourth- harmonic changes preferred axis. This effect is found to be driven by the interplay of transition dipole matrix elements and interband excitations between very narrow bands near the Fermi level. We expect the tunable anisotropy of high-harmonics to enable novel optical switching devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从反演对称性破缺产生偶次谐波谱是众所周知的，然而，各种谐波阶次的强度和角度各向异性的可调性仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明了铁电 NbOI2 中的二次和四次谐波在近红外区域表现出明显的波长依赖性和各向异性。特别是，当入射光的波长从 2150 nm 调谐到 2450 nm 时，二次谐波对于沿铁电极轴的激发保持最强，而四次谐波的偏振则改变优选轴。人们发现这种效应是由过渡偶极子矩阵元素和费米能级附近非常窄的带之间的带间激发的相互作用驱动的。

full_list.abstract: Nature Nanotechnology, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02309-8 Stacking-controllable 2D In2Se3 grown by chemical vapour deposition reveals a strong dependence of ferroelectricity on stacking order. A 2H/3R homojunction memristor achieves an on/off ratio one order of magnitude higher than that of pure-phase devices, offering opportunities for advanced ferroelectric memory applications.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《多铁性 NiI 2 中自旋螺旋态的维度交叉和局部应变引起的偏转》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Upper Bound on the Correlation Energy of a Dense Fermi Gas in the Thermodynamic Limit
full_list.title_zh: 热力学极限下稠密费米气体相关能的上限
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25262v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that the random phase approximation provides an upper bound on the correlation energy of a three-dimensional, weakly interacting, Fermi gas in the thermodynamic limit at high density. More precisely, we consider a mean-field scaling regime where the kinetic and interaction Hamiltonian are scaled by ρ⁻²/³ and ρ⁻¹, respectively. We use a correlated trial state constructed through a quasi-bosonic Bogoliubov transformation of collective particle--hole excitations associated to patches on the Fermi surface. Key of the proof is to control the position-space localization of the collective excitations. Combined with an iterated Duhamel expansion of the expectation values of (localized) particle number operators we obtain extensive estimates, which justify the reduction to an effective quadratic Hamiltonian and its approximate diagonalization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们证明，随机相近似为三维弱相互作用费米气体在高密度热力学极限下的相关能提供了上限。更准确地说，我们考虑平均场标度制度，其中动力学和相互作用哈密顿量分别按 ρ⁻²/³ 和 ρ⁻1 进行缩放。我们使用通过与费米表面上的斑块相关的集体粒子空穴激发的准玻色子博戈留波夫变换构建的相关试验状态。证明的关键是控制集体激励的位置空间局部化。结合（局部）粒子数算子的期望值的迭代杜哈梅尔展开，我们获得了广泛的估计，这证明了有效二次哈密顿量及其近似对角化的简化。

full_list.title_en: Accurate Atomic Correlation Energies and Virial Trends for Correlation-Consistent Effective Core Potentials III: Quantitative Separation of Fixed-Node Biases and Localization Errors in Cs-Rn
full_list.title_zh: 准确的原子关联能和相关一致有效核心势的维里趋势 III：Cs-Rn 中固定节点偏差和定位误差的定量分离
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic benchmarks for sixth-period elements (Cs-Rn) are established to sub-millihartree precision under correlation-consistent effective core potentials (ccECPs) using coupled-cluster [up to CCSDT(Q)] and full configuration interaction methods. These references systematically characterize electron correlation, potential-to-kinetic energy partitioning, and combined fixed-node and locality biases (η) in fixed-node diffusion Monte Carlo (FNDMC). The valence kinetic-to-total energy ratio (ξ) departs from the non-relativistic all-electron Coulombic virial limit (ξ=100%), remaining confined between 25.8% and 37.6%. The Un-pseudizing of semi-core shells decreases ξ as the attractive potential energy deepens faster than the accompanying kinetic energy escalates. Periodic trends in ξ reveal a 5d plateau near 34%, with a lanthanide-contraction-driven maximum in Hf, followed by a sharp decline across the 6p block. In FNDMC, η escalates rapidly at the onset of group-1/2 and toward the 6p closed-shell limit, peaking at 5.42% in Rn. Although fixed-node errors dominate η in most sixth-period elements, a locality error inversion occurs in Bi, with Pb exhibiting comparable error magnitudes. Furthermore, core-valence partitioning alters trial wavefunction nodal topology: in Tl, three-dimensional nodal cross-sections reveal isolated toroidal domains that confine walkers. This work completes the periodic-table-wide ccECP database from H to Rn, revealing how pseudopotential choices govern energy partitioning, nodal topology, and the balance between fixed-node and localization errors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 使用耦合簇[高达CCSDT(Q)]和全配置交互方法，在相关一致的有效核心势(ccECP)下建立了亚毫哈特精度的第六周期元素(Cs-Rn)的原子基准。这些参考文献系统地描述了固定节点扩散蒙特卡罗 (FNDMC) 中的电子相关性、势能到动能分配以及固定节点和局部偏差 (η) 的组合。价动能与总能量之比 (xi) 偏离非相对论全电子库仑维里极限 (xi=100%)，仍限制在 25.8% 到 37.6% 之间。由于吸引势能加深的速度快于伴随动能增加的速度，半核壳的非伪化会降低 Ψ 。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 使用耦合簇[高达CCSDT(Q)]和全配置交互方法，在相关一致的有效核心势(ccECP)下建立了亚毫哈特精度的第六周期元素(Cs-Rn)的原子基准。这些参考文献系统地描述了固定节点扩散蒙特卡罗 (FNDMC) 中的电子相关性、势能到动能分配以及固定节点和局部偏差 (η) 的组合。价动能与总能量之比 (xi) 偏离非相对论全电子库仑维里极限 (xi=100%)，仍限制在 25.8% 到 37.6% 之间。由于吸引势能加深的速度快于伴随动能增加的速度，半核壳的非伪化会降低 Ψ 。 Ψ 的周期性趋势显示 5d 处于接近 34% 的稳定状态，Hf 出现由镧系元素收缩驱动的最大值，随后在 6p 区块急剧下降。在 FNDMC 中，η 在 1/2 组开始时迅速升高并接近 6p 闭壳极限，在 Rn 中达到峰值 5.42%。尽管固定节点误差在大多数第六周期元素中占主导地位，但 Bi 中发生局部误差反转，而 Pb 表现出可比的误差幅度。此外，核价划分改变了试验波函数节点拓扑：在 T1 中，三维节点横截面揭示了限制步行者的孤立环形域。这项工作完成了从 H 到 Rn 的周期表范围内的 ccECP 数据库，揭示了赝势选择如何控制能量分配、节点拓扑以及固定节点和定位误差之间的平衡。

full_list.title_en: Optical Response in Spintronic Poisson Bolometers
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Optical Response in Spintronic Poisson Bolometers
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.14968v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Analog bolometers based on temperature-dependent phase-transition materials such as vanadium oxide (VOx) and barium titanate (BTO) represent the state of the art in uncooled infrared detectors. Recently, the first room-temperature spintronic Poisson bolometer based on magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) was proposed and demonstrated as a promising infrared detector. Unlike conventional bolometers, the spintronic Poisson bolometer operates in a probabilistic regime dominated by Poissonian noise, where the response is governed by resistance fluctuations arising from thermally activated magnetization transitions. Spontaneous transitions between two metastable magnetic states occur even in the absence of incident light, and the transition probability increases under illumination. In this work, we experimentally study the statistical properties of the optical response of the spintronic Poisson bolometer under illumination. We demonstrate that transitions in spintronic Poisson bolometers, both in the absence and presence of light, exhibit Poissonian behavior, with transition rates and interarrival times modulated by incident radiation. Under illumination, we observe a 153% increase in the count rate accompanied by a 70% reduction in interarrival time. These results establish spintronic Poisson bolometers as a promising platform for probabilistic, high-speed, and high-sensitivity infrared detection at room temperature.

full_list.title_en: Reduced Molecular Plasma Kinetics with Non-Boltzmann Vibrational Distribution
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Reduced Molecular Plasma Kinetics with Non-Boltzmann Vibrational Distribution
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vibrational kinetics can strongly affect energy transfer, chemical kinetics, and discharge behavior in molecular plasmas, but resolving all internal states is often impractical for reactor-scale simulation. Compact, physics-based vibrational closures are particularly needed when complete state-to-state (StS) data are limited. Starting from a detailed H₂ StS plasma-kinetics framework coupled to an electron-Boltzmann calculation, this work develops a reduced vibrational-kinetics formulation. The H₂ vibrational ladder is reduced to two non-Boltzmann groups that evolve their population and internal energy. State-resolved reaction rates and associated energy-exchange terms are projected onto the groups for subsequent tabulation in reactor-scale plasma models. StS-informed samples of the reduced-model are propagated for pulsed RF H₂ plasmas across a scan of pulse-averaged absorbed power and compared with the corresponding StS simulations. Predictions from the sampled models reproduce the bulk plasma response, including electron density, atomic-H density, and H₃⁺ density. Discrepancies in H⁻ production and the upper-energy-group vibrational temperature persist across the sampled reductions. This indicates a limitation of the present VDF reconstruction rather than the nominal parameter choice. Tail-sensitive processes therefore require a more accurate representation of the vibrational distribution.

full_list.title_en: Polaron localization modulates lattice-oxygen transfer in Pd/CeO₂ methane oxidation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Polaron localization modulates lattice-oxygen transfer in Pd/CeO₂ methane oxidation
full_list.abstract: Lean methane oxidation over Pd/CeO2 depends on oxygen exchange across the metal-support interface, yet descriptors that connect the electronic structure of reducible supports to catalytic oxygen supply remain elusive. Here, we isolate the effect of ceria faceting using PdOx/CeO2−y catalysts with comparable PdOx particle sizes and loadings. Contrary to the commonly reported preference for CeO2(111)-rich nano-octahedrons, catalytic activity follows the order nanocubes > nanorods > nano-octahedrons. Kinetic isotope measurements show that C-H activation remains rate determining across all morphologies, whereas microkinetic analysis identifies a support-assisted pathway involving molecular O2 activation at ceria vacancies and oxygen transfer to PdOx. Density functional theory reveals that the open (100) and (110) surfaces stabilize localized Ce3+ small polarons, while the close-packed (111) surface delocalizes vacancy-derived charge over a Ce trimer, increasing the energetic penalty for oxygen removal and transfer. These findings suggest that polaron localization can be a mechanistic descriptor linking ceria faceting to lattice-oxygen availability and methane-oxidation activity, beyond conventional measures based solely on vacancy concentration. Reactor-scale simulations using the validated microkinetics translate these intrinsic energetics into design requirements, showing that more favorable ratios between the Gibbs free energy of activation and that of oxygen transfer from the support to the PdOx (ΔG‡/ΔGlattice−oxygen transfer) enable comparable conversion with reduced catalyst inventory. This framework links defect electronic structure to catalyst selection and reactor performance and may extend to oxidation catalysis over other reducible supports.

full_list.title_en: Activating Nonstandard Axion Electrodynamics in Topological Insulator Materials
full_list.title_zh: 激活拓扑绝缘体材料中的非标准轴子电动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The conventional axion response of topological insulators (TIs) is characterized by an isotropic pseudoscalar magnetoelectric (ME) coupling rooted in band topology: the condensed matter analog of the axion field. However, as we reveal here, this and other more general ME responses can arise in existing TI materials from symmetry breaking without requiring nontrivial topology. Indeed, we show that breaking parity and time-reversal symmetries using combined electric and magnetic fields unlocks nonstandard axion electrodynamics via the controllable activation of various tensorial ME couplings, thus, going beyond the standard axion picture. Using a well-established first-principles-informed effective model for Bi-and Sb-based TI materials, we estimate the resulting ME coefficients and make concrete predictions for experiments. In particular, we identify nonreciprocal directional dichroism as a distinctive magneto-optical signature of these ME effects, therefore opening a route to engineer and probe symmetry-induced ME phenomena beyond the conventional topological response.
full_list.abstract_zh: 拓扑绝缘体 (TI) 的传统轴子响应的特点是植根于能带拓扑的各向同性赝标量磁电 (ME) 耦合：轴子场的凝聚态模拟。然而，正如我们在这里所揭示的，这种和其他更一般的 ME 响应可以在现有 TI 材料中因对称性破缺而出现，而不需要非平凡的拓扑。事实上，我们表明，利用组合电场和磁场打破奇偶校验和时间反转对称性，可以通过各种张量 ME 耦合的可控激活来解锁非标准轴子电动力学，从而超越标准轴子图。

full_list.title_en: Avalanches and Aging Driven by Parametric Amplification in Kerr Oscillator Networks
full_list.title_zh: 克尔振荡器网络中参数放大驱动的雪崩和老化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gain, loss, and nonlinearity shape the phase-space landscape of driven-dissipative systems, such as Kerr parametric oscillator (KPO) networks realized in superconducting, nanomechanical, and photonic arrays. Networks of KPOs exploit the stationary states of this landscape for Ising machines, bosonic error-correcting codes, and sensing. Yet how transients reach these states from a given initial condition remains largely unexplored. Here we show that KPO networks with nonlinear couplings can develop avalanches in their transient dynamics: rapid cascades of amplification between modes reminiscent of the relaxation avalanches of glassy systems. The mechanism is that parametric gain first activates the modes whose detuning it can overcome, and their nonlinear frequency shifts then pull dormant modes into the gain window one at a time. Dormant modes keep decaying while they wait for their turn, so every activation starts from a smaller seed and the intervals between activations grow geometrically. The network thus ages: the longer it has evolved, the slower it changes, and activations accumulate only logarithmically in time. In a 20-mode network, each dwell lasts about twice as long as the previous one. While aging delays the approach to the stationary state, additive noise sets a floor on the seeds and unsticks the network, shortening the longest dwells first while the activation sequence survives to noise several orders of magnitude stronger.
full_list.abstract_zh: 增益、损耗和非线性塑造了驱动耗散系统的相空间景观，例如在超导、纳米机械和光子阵列中实现的克尔参量振荡器 (KPO) 网络。 KPO 网络利用这种景观的静止状态来实现伊辛机、玻色纠错码和传感。然而，瞬态如何从给定的初始条件达到这些状态在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们证明具有非线性耦合的 KPO 网络可以在瞬态动力学中产生雪崩：模式之间的快速级联放大，让人想起玻璃系统的弛豫雪崩。

full_list.title_en: Bicircular light tunable topological phases and nonlinear Hall responses in odd-parity magnets
full_list.title_zh: 奇宇称磁体中的双圆光可调拓扑相位和非线性霍尔响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are an emerging class of magnetic materials that exhibit characteristic features of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Odd-wave magnets, where the momentum-dependent spin splitting follows an odd-parity form factor, provide a distinct platform for exploring unconventional magnetic and topological phenomena. In this work, we demonstrate light-induced topological phase transitions in odd-parity magnets driven by bicircular light. We show that a cascade of topological phase transitions occur as the relative amplitude ratio of the two beams is varied. These are accompanied by sharp changes of the quantum metric. We demonstrate that bicircular light unlocks nonlinear Hall responses arising from Berry curvature and quantum metric in irradiated odd-wave magnets, and formulate the underlying selection rules. Our results show that both the topology and the nonlinear responses in odd-parity magnets can be directly controlled by a bicircular drive.
full_list.abstract_zh: 交变磁体是一类新兴的磁性材料，具有铁磁体和反铁磁体的特征。奇波磁体，其中动量相关的自旋分裂遵循奇宇称形状因子，为探索非常规磁性和拓扑现象提供了一个独特的平台。在这项工作中，我们演示了双圆光驱动的奇宇称磁体中的光诱导拓扑相变。我们表明，当两束光束的相对振幅比发生变化时，会发生一系列拓扑相变。这些都伴随着量子度量的急剧变化。我们证明双圆光可以解锁受辐射奇波磁体中的贝里曲率和量子度量产生的非线性霍尔响应，并制定基本的选择规则。

full_list.title_en: Boundary Element Modeling for THz-SNOM Near-Field Probes
full_list.title_zh: THz-SNOM近场探针的边界元建模
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Terahertz scanning near-field optical microscopy (THz-SNOM) enables spatially and spectrally resolved investigation of low-energy collective and topological states in quantum materials and nano-structured devices by exploiting the strongly localized near field generated by a polarized atomic force microscopy (AFM) tip. Because the THz near-field response is highly sensitive to tip geometry, understanding how geometric parameters control field confinement and decay is essential for selecting tip designs that provide the spatial resolution required for specific experiments. In this work, we develop a boundary element method (BEM) for modeling the electrostatic near-field of a conducting AFM tip in response to an external background field. The tip is represented by a simplified closed, blunt-cone geometry with its surface discretized into panels using increased mesh density near the apex. A modified Green's function is used to calculate interactions between surface panels, while an augmented linear system simultaneously enforces the equipotential boundary condition on the conducting surface and overall charge neutrality to determine the induced surface-charge distribution. We validate the BEM by comparing the resulting near-field decay with that obtained from a three-dimensional quasi-static COMSOL Multiphysics simulation. The BEM accurately reproduces the COMSOL field-decay behavior while requiring orders of magnitude fewer mesh elements and substantially reducing computational cost. These results demonstrate that the BEM provides an accurate and computationally efficient framework for systematically investigating the dependence of THz near-field confinement on AFM tip geometry. This framework can be extended to more complex and experimentally realistic tip geometries, providing a route toward rational tip selection and design for application-specific spatial-resolution requirements.
full_list.abstract_zh: 太赫兹扫描近场光学显微镜（ THz-SNOM ）通过利用偏振原子力显微镜（ AFM ）尖端产生的强定位近场，实现了对量子材料和纳米结构器件中低能量集体和拓扑状态的空间和光谱分辨研究。由于太赫兹近场响应对尖端几何形状高度敏感，因此了解几何参数如何控制场限制和衰减对于选择提供特定实验所需空间分辨率的尖端设计至关重要。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种边界元法（ BEM ） ，用于响应外部背景场对导电AFM尖端的静电近场进行建模。

full_list.title_en: Certifying Nonlocal Spin Quantum Entanglement from Local Tunneling Spectra
full_list.title_zh: 从局域隧道光谱证明非局域自旋量子纠缠
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24440v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum entanglement is intrinsically nonlocal, whereas tunneling spectroscopy measures one site at a time. We show that this apparent mismatch can be overcome: local tunneling spectra can certify spin entanglement without coherent control or absolute intensity calibration. An exact spin sum rule turns the high-bias conductance into an internal normalization, allowing the inelastic spin-flip weight to place a lower bound on the local quantum Fisher information. Total-spin conservation then fixes the otherwise inaccessible intersite fluctuation, converting two local spectra into a bound on a collective entanglement witness. We incorporate coupling to the substrate through a spectroscopic bound on spin leakage, while a hierarchy of thresholds distinguishes entanglement between the spins from entanglement with their environment. Including instrumental broadening and noise, the resulting certificate holds at a stated confidence level. These results establish a route for extracting nonlocal quantum information from equilibrium local spectroscopy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠本质上是非局域的，而隧道光谱一次测量一个位置。我们证明，这种明显的不匹配是可以克服的：局部隧道光谱可以在没有相干控制或绝对强度校准的情况下证明自旋纠缠。精确的自旋和规则将高偏置电导转化为内部归一化，允许非弹性自旋翻转权重为局部量子费希尔信息设置下限。然后，全自旋守恒修复了原本无法访问的位点间涨落，将两个局部光谱转换为集体纠缠见证的界限。我们通过自旋泄漏的光谱界限将耦合与基底结合起来，而阈值的层次结构则区分自旋之间的纠缠和与其环境的纠缠。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Certifying Nonlocal Spin Quantum Entanglement from Local Tunneling Spectra》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Charge disproportionation and spin ordering in LiV₂O₅ and NaV₂O₅: a distributed moment point of view
full_list.title_zh: LiV ₂ O和NaV ₂ O中的电荷歧化和自旋有序：一个分布式力矩观点
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effects of charge disproportionation between V⁴⁺ and V⁵⁺ on the exchange interactions and related magnetic, electronic and optical properties are studied in LiV₂O₅ and NaV₂O₅. The magnetic exchange interactions between local moments on atomic sites are calculated using a linear response approach based on the QSGW band structure. While the induced magnetic moments are small on the vanadyl Oᵥ and bridge O_b, their exchange interactions with the V are found to be larger than between V atoms. The Néel temperature T_N are calculated within the mean-field (MFA) and random phase (RPA) approximations for two different crystal structures with P2₁mn and Pmmn spacegroups. The critical temperatures are are corrected by a quantum statistical factor of (S+1)/S to obtain reasonable agreement with experiment. Band structures, optical dielectric functions calculated using the Bethe Salpeter Equation method and spin waves are also calculated and presented for both crystal structures and both compounds. The spin wave dispersions are calculated from the classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian including magnetic moments on both V and O atoms. Besides the lowest energy weakly interacting spin waves of the two chains of spins in the unit cell, the model predicts additional high energy optical spin waves, which correspond to more complex spin excitations in which the spins on the two V across a bridge, vanadyl O and bridge O precess independently from each other instead of staying locked together according to their collinear alignment in the ground state. These show only weak dispersion and extend up to about 1 eV but we argue that these are an artefact of using the Heisenberg model beyond its validity range and would be suppressed in a more complete theory that allows for coupling of the transverse spin with longitudinal spin and charge excitations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究了LiV2O5和NaV2O5中V⁴⁺和V⁵⁺之间的电荷歧化对交换相互作用以及相关磁、电子和光学性质的影响。使用基于 QSGW 能带结构的线性响应方法计算原子位点上局部矩之间的磁交换相互作用。虽然氧钒基 Oᵥ 和桥 O_b 上的感应磁矩很小，但它们与 V 的交换相互作用被发现大于 V 原子之间的交换相互作用。尼尔温度 T_N 是在具有 P2₁mn 和 Pmmn 空间群的两种不同晶体结构的平均场 (MFA) 和随机相 (RPA) 近似内计算的。

full_list.title_en: Chiral symmetry and the orbital susceptibility of disordered honeycomb flakes
full_list.title_zh: 无序蜂窝状薄片的手性对称性和轨道磁化率
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The orbital susceptibility of a small disordered grain is dominated by rare samples in which an occupied and an empty level nearly touch. In a chaotic grain such near-degeneracies are suppressed by level repulsion and must also coincide with the chemical potential, so the mean susceptibility stays finite. In a neutral honeycomb flake, chiral (sublattice) symmetry removes the second condition: It places the chemical potential in the middle of the smallest gap, in every disorder realization. Here we show that the mean orbital susceptibility then grows as ln(1/T) at low temperature T if disorder can close this gap while a magnetic field still mixes the two levels, and that the hopping geometry decides whether it can: Positive nearest-neighbor hopping on a compact hexagonal flake keeps the gap open, third-neighbor hopping allows it to close. In a chiral random-matrix model with n level pairs the coefficient of the logarithm is Cₙ=sqrt2/n,Γ[(n+1)/2]/Γ(n/2), close to unity, and a detuned chemical potential cuts the logarithm off.
full_list.abstract_zh: 小无序颗粒的轨道磁化率主要由占据的能级和空能级几乎接触的稀有样本决定。在混沌颗粒中，这种近简并性受到能级排斥的抑制，并且也必须与化学势一致，因此平均磁化率保持有限。在中性蜂窝状薄片中，手性（亚晶格）对称性消除了第二个条件：它将化学势放置在每个无序实现中的最小间隙的中间。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 小无序颗粒的轨道磁化率主要由占据的能级和空能级几乎接触的稀有样本决定。在混沌颗粒中，这种近简并性受到能级排斥的抑制，并且也必须与化学势一致，因此平均磁化率保持有限。在中性蜂窝状薄片中，手性（亚晶格）对称性消除了第二个条件：它将化学势放置在每个无序实现中的最小间隙的中间。在这里，我们表明，如果无序可以关闭这个带隙，而磁场仍然混合两个能级，那么平均轨道磁化率在低温 T 下会以 ln(1/T) 的形式增长，并且跳跃几何形状决定它是否可以：紧凑六边形薄片上的正最近邻跳变使带隙保持打开，第三邻跳变允许它关闭。在具有 n 个水平对的手性随机矩阵模型中，对数系数为 Cₙ=sqrt2/n, Г[(n+1)/2]/Г(n/2)，接近于 1，并且失谐的化学势切断了对数。

full_list.title_en: Coherence and pairing enhancement in a trilayer cuprate with layer-selective charge order
full_list.title_zh: 具有层选择性电荷顺序的三层铜酸盐中的相干性和配对增强
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2506.01448v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Trilayer cuprates hold the record for the highest superconducting critical temperatures (Tc), yet the underlying mechanism remains elusive. Using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (tr-ARPES), we uncover a striking interplay between charge order, superconducting gap magnitude, and quasiparticle coherence in Bi₂Sr₂Ca₂Cu₃O₁₀₊δ (Bi2223). We present ARPES-based evidence of charge order on the inner CuO₂ plane -- as confirmed via resonant x-ray scattering (RXS) -- and show that the same inner plane hosts a large superconducting gap matching its doping, firmly establishing it as underdoped. Despite its underdoped nature, the inner plane also exhibits an exceptional degree of quasiparticle coherence; suppressing charge-order fluctuations further enhances this, making it comparable to that of the overdoped outer planes at elevated electronic temperatures. At the same time, on the overdoped outer planes we find larger superconducting gaps than what is seen on comparably doped single and bilayer cuprates, indicating an unexpected and simultaneous enhancement of both coherence and pairing interactions in Bi2223. These findings, supported by complementary single- and three-layer Hubbard model calculations, reveal a unique interlayer mechanism in which both pairing strength and phase coherence are optimized when interfacing planes with distinct hole concentrations, providing new microscopic insight into the record Tc of Bi2223.
full_list.abstract_zh: 三层铜酸盐保持着最高超导临界温度（Tc）的记录，但其基本机制仍然难以捉摸。利用时间和角度分辨光电子能谱 (tr-ARPES)，我们发现了 Bi2Sr2Ca2Cu₃O₁₀₊δ (Bi2223) 中电荷顺序、超导能隙大小和准粒子相干性之间的惊人相互作用。我们提出了基于 ARPES 的内 CuO2 平面上电荷顺序的证据（通过共振 X 射线散射 (RXS) 证实），并表明同一内平面具有与其掺杂相匹配的大超导间隙，从而牢固地确定其为欠掺杂。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 三层铜酸盐保持着最高超导临界温度（Tc）的记录，但其基本机制仍然难以捉摸。利用时间和角度分辨光电子能谱 (tr-ARPES)，我们发现了 Bi2Sr2Ca2Cu₃O₁₀₊δ (Bi2223) 中电荷顺序、超导能隙大小和准粒子相干性之间的惊人相互作用。我们提出了基于 ARPES 的内 CuO2 平面上电荷顺序的证据（通过共振 X 射线散射 (RXS) 证实），并表明同一内平面具有与其掺杂相匹配的大超导间隙，从而牢固地确定其为欠掺杂。尽管其掺杂不足的性质，内平面也表现出异常程度的准粒子相干性。抑制电荷序波动进一步增强了这一点，使其与电子温度升高时的过掺杂外层相当。与此同时，在过掺杂的外平面上，我们发现比同等掺杂的单层和双层铜酸盐上看到的超导能隙更大，这表明 Bi2223 中的相干性和配对相互作用出人意料地同时增强。这些发现得到互补的单层和三层哈伯德模型计算的支持，揭示了一种独特的层间机制，其中当将具有不同空穴浓度的平面连接时，配对强度和相位相干性都得到优化，从而为 Bi2223 的记录 Tc 提供了新的微观见解。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Coherence and pairing enhancement in a trilayer cuprate with layer-selective charge order》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Development of microwave multiplexed readout for athermal phonon TES-based detectors
full_list.title_zh: 开发用于基于 TES 的无热声子探测器的微波多路复用读出器
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24300v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continued advancements in sub-eV calorimetric measurements are being enabled through the athermal phonon detection channel, with applications spanning a diverse array of fields, including low-mass dark matter searches, coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering, and quantum information science. While Transition Edge Sensors (TESs) have achieved the lowest thresholds to date, they face significant scalability bottlenecks due to the inherent constraints of conventional SQUID readout architectures. To address this limitation, we present an update on R&D to develop practical, highly multiplexed, microwave readout for athermal phonon TESs, which can enable a dramatic increase in both sensor count and target mass, with a focus on sub-GeV dark matter searches as a target application. This work leverages advances from highly scaled mm-wave, x-ray, and gamma-ray TES systems, adapting them to the unique needs of low-threshold rare event measurements. We quantify the basic readout functionality and noise level in our dilution refrigerator testbed and demonstrate operation of a variety of TES devices with saturation powers significantly lower than mm-wave and x-ray devices. We demonstrate proof-of-concept multiplexed readout of background event pulses, bound the readout's contribution to the parasitic TES background load to <1 fW, and discuss a cryogenic inline RF filtering scheme. These results demonstrate practical solutions to several of the key challenges that must be solved before a next-generation athermal phonon detector at scale is realized.
full_list.abstract_zh: 通过非热声子探测通道，亚电子伏特量热测量不断取得进展，其应用涵盖了各种领域，包括低质量暗物质搜索、相干弹性中微子核散射和量子信息科学。虽然过渡边缘传感器 (TES) 已达到迄今为止的最低阈值，但由于传统 SQUID 读出架构的固有限制，它们面临着严重的可扩展性瓶颈。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了研发更新，以开发用于非热声子 TES 的实用、高度多路复用的微波读出装置，这可以使传感器数量和目标质量大幅增加，重点是将次 GeV 暗物质搜索作为目标应用。

full_list.title_en: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and deconfined criticality in SrCu₂(BO₃)₂
full_list.title_zh: SrCu2(BO₃)2 中的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和解除临界临界点
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: SrCu₂(BO₃)₂ is the leading candidate for deconfined criticality, yet theories of its critical regime omit the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions, which gap the kagome Dirac spin liquid. Adding them to the SU(2) gauge theory, we show that time reversal and a spin-orbit-locked glide forbid any gauge-singlet spinon mass to all orders. In-plane DM only twists the spinons, reconstructing the nodes below 0.03-0.17 K, while out-of-plane DM is irrelevant and SO(5) anisotropy arises only at second order. The material thus remains a platform for deconfined criticality, which NMR can test, since a [100] field induces a Néel moment and a [001] field does not.
full_list.abstract_zh: SrCu2(BO₃)2 是去限制临界性的主要候选者，但其临界状态的理论忽略了 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用，这种相互作用使 Kagome Dirac 自旋液体产生间隙。将它们添加到 SU(2) 规范理论中，我们表明时间反转和自旋轨道锁定滑翔禁止所有阶的任何规范单重自旋子质量。面内 DM 仅扭曲自旋子，重建低于 0.03-0.17 K 的节点，而面外 DM 无关，SO(5) 各向异性仅在二阶出现。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: SrCu2(BO₃)2 是去限制临界性的主要候选者，但其临界状态的理论忽略了 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用，这种相互作用使 Kagome Dirac 自旋液体产生间隙。将它们添加到 SU(2) 规范理论中，我们表明时间反转和自旋轨道锁定滑翔禁止所有阶的任何规范单重自旋子质量。面内 DM 仅扭曲自旋子，重建低于 0.03-0.17 K 的节点，而面外 DM 无关，SO(5) 各向异性仅在二阶出现。因此，该材料仍然是一个不受限制的临界点的平台，NMR 可以测试该平台，因为 [100] 场会产生尼尔矩，而 [001] 场则不会。

full_list.title_en: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions in the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids
full_list.title_zh: Shastry-Sutherland 狄拉克自旋液体 SU(2) 规范理论中的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We classify the fermion bilinears of the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids under the spin-orbit-locked space group and treat the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions of SrCu₂(BO₃)₂ at leading order in 1/N and at one loop. At linear order DM can neither gap the spinons nor destabilize the SO(5) point above a scale T^*. Symmetry forbids every local gauge-singlet fermion mass at any order. Among the singlet bilinears, the in-plane couplings induce only a conserved spin current of dimension exactly 2, which sets T^*=4λsimeq0.03-0.17 K, and the out-of-plane coupling only a flavored spin-2 current, irrelevant at a unitary critical point. DM-induced Yukawa couplings start below 2% of the one that bounds the pseudocritical window. In zero field, measured samples order above 1 K, at or above T^*. Below T^*, in a two-dimensional sample at the critical pressure, the Dirac cones reconstruct into a chirally protected d-wave quadratic band touching whose only gauge-singlet gap channels are the two valence-bond components and the scalar chirality. A one-loop flow, with the gauge field screened by the band touching, ends at T**sim(0.03-0.1)λ on a ray containing valence-bond order for the material's exchange and for most random couplings, and otherwise on a gapped chiral Z₂ spin liquid. The DM bias between the two plaquette patterns is at most of order 10⁻⁴, with a direction not fixed at O(1/N), whereas non-magnetic quenched disorder couples a relevant random field to the plaquette doublet and none to the chirality. A field along [100] induces a (π,π) Néel moment linear in the field; a field along [001] does not. This selection rule also holds in the dimer phase and is testable by ¹¹B NMR under pressure.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们对自旋轨道锁定空间群下的 Shastry-Sutherland Dirac 自旋液体的 SU(2) 规范理论的费米子双线性进行分类，并在 1/N 和一个循环中处理 SrCu2(BO3)2 的前导阶 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用。在线性阶上，DM 既不能使自旋子间隙，也不能破坏 T^* 尺度之上的 SO(5) 点的稳定性。对称性禁止任何阶的局部规范单线态费米子质量。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们对自旋轨道锁定空间群下的 Shastry-Sutherland Dirac 自旋液体的 SU(2) 规范理论的费米子双线性进行分类，并在 1/N 和一个循环中处理 SrCu2(BO3)2 的前导阶 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用。在线性阶上，DM 既不能使自旋子间隙，也不能破坏 T^* 尺度之上的 SO(5) 点的稳定性。对称性禁止任何阶的局部规范单线态费米子质量。在单重态双线性中，面内耦合仅引起维度恰好为 2 的守恒自旋电流，这使得 T^*=4λsimeq0.03-0.17 K，而面外耦合仅引起风味自旋 2 电流，在酉临界点不相关。 DM 引起的汤川耦合开始时低于伪临界窗口边界耦合的 2%。在零场中，测量的样本阶数高于 1 K，等于或高于 T^*。在 T^* 以下，在临界压力下的二维样本中，狄拉克锥重构为手性保护的 d 波二次带接触，其唯一的规范单重态间隙通道是两个价键分量和标量手性。单环流（其规范场由能带接触屏蔽）在包含材料交换和大多数随机耦合的价键序的射线上终止于 T**sim(0.03-0.1)λ，否则在有间隙的手性 Z2 自旋液体上终止。两个斑块图案之间的 DM 偏差最多为 10⁻⁴ 量级，方向不固定为 O(1/N)，而非磁性猝灭无序将相关随机场耦合到斑块双峰，而不耦合到手性。沿 [100] 的场在场中产生线性 (π,π) Néel 矩；沿 [001] 的字段则不然。该选择规则在二聚体相中也成立，并且可以在压力下通过 11 B NMR 进行测试。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Shastry-Sutherland 狄拉克自旋液体 SU(2) 规范理论中的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Emergent Chirality Reversal in Magnetically Driven Rotor Clusters
full_list.title_zh: 磁驱动转子簇中的紧急手性反转
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Does a collection of magnetically driven rotors necessarily rotate in the same direction as its individual members? We show that rotors driven by a rotating magnetic field self-assemble into clusters whose collective rotation can oppose the self-rotation of every rotor within them. The reversal arises from competition between rotation-translation coupling and dipolar interactions, which favor opposite directions of collective rotation. Their balance varies with system size and driving frequency, producing a transition between the two handed states, while hydrodynamic interactions shift the transition boundary. Collective handedness can thus emerge opposite to the field-imposed single-rotor rotation without reversing the external field, and can be tuned through system size and driving frequency.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁力驱动转子的集合是否必须与其各个部件以相同的方向旋转？我们证明，由旋转磁场驱动的转子会自组装成簇，其集体旋转可以对抗其中每个转子的自旋转。这种逆转是由旋转-平移耦合和偶极相互作用之间的竞争引起的，有利于集体旋转的相反方向。它们的平衡随着系统尺寸和驱动频率的变化而变化，从而在两个手态之间产生过渡，而流体动力学相互作用则改变过渡边界。因此，集体旋向可以与场强加的单转子旋转相反，而无需反转外部场，并且可以通过系统尺寸和驱动频率进行调整。

full_list.title_en: End-to-End Optimization of Partial Fault Tolerance in Neutral-Atom Arrays
full_list.title_zh: 中性原子阵列部分容错的端到端优化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26471v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fault-tolerant (FT) quantum computation offers a pathway to quantum advantage, but its realization is hindered by its significant overhead. The partially FT "STAR" architecture reduces the cost of universal computation at the price of relaxing FT requirements for non-Clifford operations, increasing exposure to hardware noise. Therefore, maximizing its performance and applicability demands careful co-design with the underlying hardware. In this work we investigate the co-design of the STAR architecture with neutral-atom platforms, connecting the underlying atomic physics to logical error modeling and application-level performance. At the physical level, we identify a favorable noise bias in ¹⁷¹Yb Rydberg gates, and show how it can be enhanced through error-selective pulse optimization. At the logical level, we identify an intrinsic error suppression mechanism, yielding vanishing logical coherent noise in leading order. Detailed circuit-level simulations of surface code implementations show more than an order of magnitude reduction in logical error relative to previous estimates. As a concrete target application, we focus on the Fermi-Hubbard model with periodic boundaries, for which we design a simulation circuit particularly suited to early implementations. We quantify the resource tradeoff of partially and fully FT approaches to gate synthesis, with the former showing approximately an order of magnitude reduction in state-injection depth, and an even larger reduction in Clifford resources. Comparing with classical and fully FT approaches, we identify regimes where partial fault tolerance provides both lower overheads and lower error rates. In our estimates, this is accessible with moderate error rates psim 10⁻³ and a few thousand qubits, underlining that for these types of problems, partial FT approaches provide a compelling pathway to early quantum advantage.
full_list.abstract_zh: 容错（FT）量子计算提供了一条获得量子优势的途径，但其实现却因其巨大的开销而受到阻碍。部分 FT“STAR”架构降低了通用计算的成本，但代价是放宽了非 Clifford 操作的 FT 要求，增加了硬件噪声的风险。因此，最大限度地提高其性能和适用性需要与底层硬件进行仔细的协同设计。在这项工作中，我们研究了 STAR 架构与中性原子平台的协同设计，将底层原子物理与逻辑错误建模和应用程序级性能联系起来。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 容错（FT）量子计算提供了一条获得量子优势的途径，但其实现却因其巨大的开销而受到阻碍。部分 FT“STAR”架构降低了通用计算的成本，但代价是放宽了非 Clifford 操作的 FT 要求，增加了硬件噪声的风险。因此，最大限度地提高其性能和适用性需要与底层硬件进行仔细的协同设计。在这项工作中，我们研究了 STAR 架构与中性原子平台的协同设计，将底层原子物理与逻辑错误建模和应用程序级性能联系起来。在物理层面，我们确定了 171Yb Rydberg 门中有利的噪声偏差，并展示了如何通过误差选择性脉冲优化来增强它。在逻辑层面，我们确定了一种内在的错误抑制机制，在前导顺序中产生消失的逻辑相干噪声。表面代码实现的详细电路级仿真表明，相对于之前的估计，逻辑错误减少了一个数量级以上。作为具体的目标应用，我们专注于具有周期性边界的费米-哈伯德模型，为此我们设计了特别适合早期实现的模拟电路。我们量化了部分和完全 FT 门综合方法的资源权衡，前者显示出状态注入深度大约有一个数量级的减少，而 Clifford 资源的减少甚至更大。与经典和完全 FT 方法相比，我们确定了部分容错机制可以提供较低的开销和较低的错误率。根据我们的估计，这可以通过适中的错误率 psim 10³ 和几千个量子位来实现，这强调了对于这些类型的问题，部分 FT 方法为早期量子优势提供了一条令人信服的途径。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Epitaxial Displacement-etched GaAsSb Quantum Dots Emitting at Telecom Wavelengths
full_list.title_zh: 外延位移蚀刻 GaAsSb 量子点在电信波长下发射
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.24768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are essential components for integrated photonic and quantum information systems, yet current epitaxial growth techniques face significant limitations in complexity of growth, material selection, and density tunability. Here we report a displacement etch technique that enables controlled formation of GaAsSb QDs with emission at telecommunications wavelengths. Our approach uses arsenic molecular flux (As₂) to react with antimonide surfaces through thermodynamically favorable displacement reactions, creating three-dimensional quantum confined nanostructures without requiring strain-driven growth or complex droplet-based processes. Density functional theory shows the two competing As-for-Sb exchange pathways to be nearly equivalent in both reaction energy and activation barrier, which places morphological control in the subsequent adatom kinetics rather than in the surface reaction itself. A single process parameter, the As₂ exposure, sets the QD areal density across three orders of magnitude, from 10² to 10⁵ μ m⁻², covering both isolated emitters and dense gain media. Structural analysis reveals well-defined GaAsSb QDs with a mixed GaAs/GaSb composition and no extended defects. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence measurements confirm emission at 1550 nm (0.8 eV) within the telecommunications C-band, with characteristic QD-like temperature dependence. Because the QDs form on a lattice-matched GaSb surface in a single growth step, the technique offers a practical route to C-band emitters built into the GaSb/AlGaSb device family already used for mid-infrared sources and detectors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 半导体量子点（QD）是集成光子和量子信息系统的重要组成部分，但当前的外延生长技术在生长复杂性、材料选择和密度可调性方面面临着巨大的限制。在这里，我们报告了一种位移蚀刻技术，该技术能够控制形成在电信波长下发射的 GaAsSb QD。我们的方法使用砷分子通量（As2）通过热力学有利的置换反应与锑化物表面发生反应，创建三维量子限制纳米结构，而不需要应变驱动的生长或复杂的基于液滴的过程。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 半导体量子点（QD）是集成光子和量子信息系统的重要组成部分，但当前的外延生长技术在生长复杂性、材料选择和密度可调性方面面临着巨大的限制。在这里，我们报告了一种位移蚀刻技术，该技术能够控制形成在电信波长下发射的 GaAsSb QD。我们的方法使用砷分子通量（As2）通过热力学有利的置换反应与锑化物表面发生反应，创建三维量子限制纳米结构，而不需要应变驱动的生长或复杂的基于液滴的过程。密度泛函理论表明，两种竞争的 As-for-Sb 交换途径在反应能量和活化势垒方面几乎相等，这将形态控制置于随后的吸附原子动力学中，而不是表面反应本身。 As2 曝光这一单一工艺参数将 QD 面密度设置为三个数量级，从 10² 到 10⁵ μm⁻²，覆盖隔离发射器和密集增益介质。结构分析表明，GaAsSb 量子点结构清晰，具有混合的 GaAs/GaSb 成分，并且没有扩展缺陷。温度依赖性光致发光测量证实了电信 C 波段内 1550 nm (0.8 eV) 的发射，具有类似 QD 的温度依赖性。由于量子点是在单一生长步骤中在晶格匹配的 GaSb 表面上形成的，因此该技术为内置于已用于中红外源和探测器的 GaSb/AlGaSb 器件系列中的 C 波段发射器提供了一条实用途径。
full_list.summary: 半导体量子点（QD）是集成光子和量子信息系统的重要组成部分，但当前的外延生长技术在生长复杂性、材料选择和密度可调性方面面临着巨大的限制。在这里，我们报告了一种位移蚀刻技术，该技术能够控制形成在电信波长下发射的 GaAsSb QD。我们的方法使用砷分子通量（As2）通过热力学有利的置换反应与锑化物表面发生反应，创建三维量子限制纳米结构，而不需要应变驱动的生长或复杂的基于液滴的过程。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Epitaxial Displacement-etched GaAsSb Quantum Dots Emitting at Telecom Wavelengths》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Exploring ground state phase diagrams of Rydberg atom arrays with finite projected entangled-pair states
full_list.title_zh: 探索具有有限投影纠缠对态的里德堡原子阵列的基态相图
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.26520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg atom arrays (RAA) have been advocated as a promising avenue for the quantum simulation of different exotic quantum states. Numerical predictions for the ground state properties of this experimental platform can, however, be challenging in two-dimensional setups. In particular, faithfully treating long-range interactions is often crucial for distinguishing the fate of competing phases, but it usually comes at considerable cost. Projected entangled-pair states (PEPS), optimized via a sampling-based approach, have been shown to deal with such terms on the same ground as shorter-range ones. In this work, we employ these tools to investigate debated physical questions in different frustrated geometries of RAA, from the emergence of spin-glass physics on the Kagomé lattice to topological order beyond the PXP model on the Ruby lattice. By that, we contribute to establishing PEPS as well-suited tools for creating digital twins of RAA experiments.
full_list.abstract_zh: 里德伯原子阵列（RAA）被认为是不同奇异量子态量子模拟的一种有前途的途径。然而，在二维设置中对该实验平台的基态特性进行数值预测可能具有挑战性。特别是，忠实地处理远程相互作用对于区分竞争相的命运通常至关重要，但通常需要付出相当大的代价。通过基于采样的方法优化的投影纠缠对态（PEPS）已被证明可以在与短程术语相同的基础上处理这些术语。

full_list.title_en: Ferroelastic domain wall driven glassy dynamics and photoresponse in a SrTiO₃ (111) two-dimensional electron gas
full_list.title_zh: SrTiO₃ (111) 二维电子气中铁弹性畴壁驱动的玻璃态动力学和光响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.25943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The (111) orientation of SrTiO₃ (STO)-based heterostructures has emerged as a versatile platform for two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs), yet the influence of STO's polar ferroelastic domain-wall (DW) network on charge transport remains largely unexplored. Here we study AlOₓ/STO (111) interfaces hosting 2DEGs of different carrier densities. In the lower-density 2DEG, low-temperature transport exhibits thermal hysteresis, slow resistance relaxation, cooling-rate dependence, and memory effects, signaling glasslike electron dynamics. The relaxation is strongly non-monotonic in temperature, increasing below sim80 K, peaking near 25 K, and vanishing below sim12 K, tracking the established evolution of the ferroelastic DW state of bulk STO rather than any electronic energy scale, which identifies the DW network as its origin. These signatures are absent in a second, more metallic interface with much higher carrier density, demonstrating that the electron-DW coupling can be tuned. We further show that polar DWs govern the photoresponse: the persistent photoconductivity rises sharply below sim80 K, coinciding with the onset of DW polarity. Together, these results establish polar ferroelastic DWs as a carrier-density-tunable electronic degree of freedom in STO (111)-based 2DEGs, opening routes to manipulate 2DEG properties through topological defects.
full_list.abstract_zh: 基于 SrTiO₃ (STO) 的异质结构的 (111) 取向已成为二维电子气 (2DEG) 的通用平台，但 STO 的极性铁弹性畴壁 (DW) 网络对电荷传输的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们研究承载不同载流子密度的 2DEG 的 AlOₓ/STO (111) 接口。在较低密度的 2DEG 中，低温输运表现出热滞后、缓慢的电阻松弛、冷却速率依赖性和记忆效应，表明玻璃状电子动力学。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 基于 SrTiO₃ (STO) 的异质结构的 (111) 取向已成为二维电子气 (2DEG) 的通用平台，但 STO 的极性铁弹性畴壁 (DW) 网络对电荷传输的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们研究承载不同载流子密度的 2DEG 的 AlOₓ/STO (111) 接口。在较低密度的 2DEG 中，低温输运表现出热滞后、缓慢的电阻松弛、冷却速率依赖性和记忆效应，表明玻璃状电子动力学。弛豫在温度上是强烈非单调的，在 sim80 K 以下增加，在 25 K 附近达到峰值，并在 sim12 K 以下消失，跟踪块体 STO 铁弹 DW 状态的既定演化，而不是任何电子能量尺度，这将 DW 网络识别为其起源。这些特征在第二个更具金属性、载流子密度更高的界面中不存在，这表明电子-DW 耦合是可以调节的。我们进一步表明，极性 DW 控制光响应：持续光电导率在 sim80 K 以下急剧上升，与 DW 极性的开始一致。总之，这些结果将极性铁弹 DW 确立为基于 STO (111) 的 2DEG 中载流子密度可调的电子自由度，开辟了通过拓扑缺陷操纵 2DEG 特性的途径。
